action_items: Replace 'missile' MaterialCommunityIcons name with a valid one (e.g., 'rocket-launch') in builder icon map to remove repeated console warnings.
Migrate props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents in hud/touchable wrappers to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py apply_energy_regen swallows ValueError on malformed resources_updated_at silently — acceptable but consider logging.
server.py: robot delete refund does not check that the robot's player still exists; if player was deleted the $inc silently no-ops (fine, but worth a note).
server.py: no validation that request Threat payload in /api/battle wasn't tampered client-side — a client could send arbitrary rewards. Consider server-side threat regeneration or signing.
compute_generation uses sorted(GEN_UNLOCK_RESEARCH.items()) each call — trivial cost but could be precomputed as a tuple.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer lifespan handler (carry-over from iteration 1).
